sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule III — Excavation and Foundation Requirements
sources.description: Governs excavation, shoring, foundation construction, and protection of adjoining properties during construction.

sources.label: NSCP 2015, Chapter 3 — Foundations
sources.description: Provides technical standards for foundation design including shallow foundations, deep foundations, and soil bearing capacity requirements.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Section 1205 — Veneer Requirements

sources.description: Provides structural design standards for masonry walls and veneer anchorage systems.
